name: cpdd
blurb: Chinese gaming slang: "looking for a CP (partner), hit me up"
title: CPDD Meaning: What Does CPDD Mean in Chinese Games?
description: CPDD means "CP 滴滴": looking for a CP (gaming partner or couple), message me. Common in Chinese mobile games. Examples and safety tips.
answer: CPDD is short for "CP 滴滴": CP comes from "couple", a pair; DD is 滴滴 (dī dī), "ping me, message me". Together it means "looking for a CP, DM me if you're interested". It is common in public chat channels of games like Honor of Kings (王者荣耀) and QQ Speed (QQ飞车). The CP can be a regular duo partner or someone to date.

body: CP is short for couple. In fan fiction and fan circles it means a pairing of characters or people; more broadly it means a couple or a fixed pair. In many Chinese mobile games, players can bind as a couple, play together and unlock special badges, so "forming a CP" is a real in-game thing.

DD is usually explained as 滴滴, the beep of a message or the sound of a ping: "beep me". So CPDD is a public ad for a partner, waiting for replies or friend requests. Some people write it as DDCP; the meaning is the same.

ul: cpdd，主玩辅助，晚上在线 (CPDD, I main support, online in the evenings)
国服打野 cpdd，只组队不谈恋爱 (top-ranked jungler, CPDD, teaming up only, no dating)
有没有一起玩 QQ 飞车的，cpdd (anyone play QQ Speed? CPDD)
你又在公屏 cpdd 了？ (you're posting CPDD in public chat again?)
dd，我也玩射手 (DD, I play marksman too), as a reply

body: Since the letters alone hide the meaning, users made up joke expansions such as 脆皮弟弟 ("fragile little bro") or 臭屁弟弟 ("cocky little bro"). They are teasing; the real meaning is still CP 滴滴.

CPDD is mostly used by young players, and public partner-hunting can attract people with bad intentions. Be wary of anyone who asks for money, top-ups, skins as gifts, joining unknown groups or meeting offline. Minors in particular should never share their real name, school or address.
If you only want a duo partner, say so clearly, for example 只组队 ("teaming only").

faq.q: What does DD mean in CPDD?
faq.a: DD is 滴滴 (dī dī), "ping me" or "message me". CPDD means "looking for a CP, message me".

faq.q: How should I reply to CPDD?
faq.a: If interested, reply "dd" or send a private message. It's worth asking whether they want a teammate or a date.

faq.q: Does CPDD always mean looking for a girlfriend or boyfriend?
faq.a: No. Many players just want a regular gaming partner; others are looking for romance. Check their message or ask.
